anchoredLines.line: 🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Tomás Frost and Grace Sato will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Hana Kowalski and Mei Kowalski and Ines Haddad and Oscar Mendez and Sofia Hassan and Ruth Mendez will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Malik Garcia and Sofia Tanaka will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
